public_rationale: A documented January 25, 2024 test shows GPT-4 confidently giving false legal information about voting attire. That supports the ordinary reading that improved OpenAI assistants still produced authoritative-sounding falsehoods. The same evaluation found substantial strengths, so this is evidence of a remaining failure mode, not general uselessness or uniformly poor accuracy.
limitations: A false assertion does not establish the internal mechanism that produced it.
The evaluation used an API model; results need not match every ChatGPT interface or configuration.
If the claim refers exclusively to a particular unnamed 2022 intervention, this evidence would not settle that narrower claim.
